{{Quote|What are we waiting for?|Zinn Paulness, in response to a cry to vote on a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill in the Senate]]|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
'''Zinn Paulness''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] when [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and his posse of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raided]] it and took hostages. He was also present at the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They attack, and ''now'' they want peace?|Zinn Paulness|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
[[File:ZinnPaulness-HOBS.png|thumb|left|200px|Paulness calls for a vote after the [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombing of the Coruscant power generator]].]]
Zinn Paulness was a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was present during the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the Senate when he and other senators were having a discussion on the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]] before a Senate meeting. He was held as a hostage under laser-activated bombs, so that Bane could reason with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for the release of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].

However, Bane went back on his word, and once the Chancellor released Ziro, Bane detonated the bombs regardless. Despite this, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was able to get Paulness and the other senators out of the hall, cutting a hole in the floor with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] before the charges went off.

Later on, the Senate called an emergency session to debate the cost of the war. When fellow Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] suggested that the Republic negotiate with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and was later present during the vote to negotiate with the Separatists. Sadly the vote was stopped due to power failure from a [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|bombing]] of the [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscant power generator]]. Due to this attack, the Senate passed the bill to deregulate the banks so the Republic could increase [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] production and rejected the Separatist peace initiative. Zinn even raised his voice to question why were they waiting to vote on the deregulation.

Zinn was also present when a new bill was proposed by Senator [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] for an additional five million clone troopers (funded by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]]). In the end Senator Padmé Amidala's speech swayed the votes and the bill was turned down after an applause by many of his colleagues and Zinn himself.

==Behind the scenes==
Zinn Paulness's character was based on a design of an [[Sateen Vestswe/Legends|Alderaanian aide]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}}</ref> He was given his first speaking role in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," but although [[Stephen Stanton]] was credited as "Senator" in the episode, and though Paulness was the only unspecified role, his voice actor was not properly credited.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> In the following episode, "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," his speaking role was credited to [[Jason Spisak]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode311.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> The character's name is an anagram of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' digital asset supervisor [[Paul Zinnes]].
